hebrewText: פֶּן יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּ/אַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְ/אֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל

tokens.bdb: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest
to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
tokens.kjv: catch, [idiom] without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, [idiom] surely, tear (in pieces).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.enLiteralWord: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.explanation: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food
tokens.explanationEn: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food

tokens.bdb: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
tokens.kjv: any, appetite, beast, body, breath, creature, [idiom] dead(-ly), desire, [idiom] (dis-) contented, [idiom] fish, ghost, [phrase] greedy, he, heart(-y), (hath, [idiom] jeopardy of) life ([idiom] in jeopardy), lust, man, me, mind, mortally, one, own, person, pleasure, (her-, him-, my-, thy-) self, them (your) -selves, [phrase] slay, soul, [phrase] tablet, they, thing, ([idiom] she) will, [idiom] would have it.

tokens.bdb: to break off or crunch; figuratively, to deliver
tokens.kjv: break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to break off or crunch; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to break off or crunch; figuratively
tokens.explanation: to break off or crunch; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: to break off or crunch; figuratively

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).

tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, defend, deliver (self), escape, [idiom] without fail, part, pluck, preserve, recover, rescue, rid, save, spoil, strip, [idiom] surely, take (out).
